scope: Theorem 8.1 of the manuscript “Scale and conformal symmetry in four-dimensional operational quantum field theory” (preprints/Scale-and-conformal-symmetry-in-four-dimensional-operational-quantum-field-theory-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 282 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 485a44682f95ef0d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 89. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every finite ordered list of L and original physical fields, the mixed analytic scalar product is the Fourier–Laplace continuation of a tempered Wightman distribution, with the ordered spectrum, adjunction, locality, and similarity covariance, with dilations acting on the original field labels. The analytic vector products have tempered Hilbert-valued boundaries with the vector spectrum. Their reflected splittings hold for joint tests and give all joint Wightman positivity inequalities in the original Hilbert space.
